description: A dataset collection is a type of view defined by a flat list of datasets.

items.description: The flat list of dataset entity references that define this collection.  Limit: 30K items.

fileSize.description: The cumulative size, in bytes, of all files referenced by each dataset. This is computed by the backend on create/update. Note that if an underlying dataset is updated this value won't automatically update.

fileCount.description: The sum of files referenced each dataset in the collection. This is computed by the backend on create/update. Note that if an underlying dataset is updated this value won't automatically update.
